Requirements: R-5, R-6
Plan row: TS-2

Red-lock note (no BUG id exists yet, so it sits in the body, not in the frontmatter key): Q2 a says the 400 "Project mismatch" from the ms_teams validator is a defect; this case is expected red until the move is accepted. It is proof of the gap, not a broken case; triage links the bug.

Obligations: OB-2, OB-3. Q2 a: Move must succeed for MS Teams.

## Given
- Two projects the acting user interpreter; the target holds no MS Teams integration.
- One MS Teams integration in the source project.

## When
1. PUT the MS Teams integration with project_name = target project.
2. List the MS Teams integrations of the source and of the target project.

## Then
1. P-msteams-move: the PUT answers 2xx, not 400 "Project mismatch".
2. The PUT response (or a GET by id) reports the target project.
3. The target project list holds exactly one MS Teams integration, the same id.
4. The source project list holds no MS Teams integration (not copied).

## Self-probe notes
- Discriminating input: a different project_name on an ms_teams type; the validator-before-move order is the defect site, observed at the PUT response and both lists.
- Then 1 asserts the status AND the absence of the mismatch text; Thens 3 and 4 read lists independently of the PUT. A fix that copies would fail Then 4.
- If the flag is off the stand returns a different error: a failure of Then 1 with a flag-related message is an environment result only after PC-1 is confirmed; an unexpected 5xx after it is a failed outcome.
- Red at S6 by design (Q2 a).

## Obligation coverage
| obligation/part | oracle | boundary | Then | residual gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OB-2 move accepted | R-5 | API PUT response | 1, 2 | none |
| OB-3 source no longer holds, target has one | R-6 | API lists | 3, 4 | none |
